g.title: ERD
g.text: Entity Relationship Diagram (3NF) - Centralized Student Portal and Automated Clearance System

g.title: legend
g.text: PK = primary key (underlined) FK = foreign key ? = nullable
Crow's foot = many double bar = exactly one bar + circle = zero or one
Table colors: blue = identity, green = academic structure, yellow = enrollment and grades,
orange = finance, pink = clearance, purple = documents, gray = security and audit
